title: FIX: Google Drive = okas2000@gmail.com only (block yonsei)
instruction: CEO: Drive was open as okas2000@yonsei.ac.kr — wrong. Pull latest scripts (lib-google-drive-account.sh). Run: bash scripts/mac-create-audiso-music-mydrive.sh AUD-MUS-20260825-004. Script refuses yonsei CloudStorage; mkdir only under ~/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-okas2000@gmail.com/My Drive (or 내 드라이브). NO API. If missing: Google Drive desktop → sign out yonsei → sign in ONLY okas2000@gmail.com → re-run.
ceo_action: Mac Drive desktop: remove yonsei, keep only okas2000@gmail.com. Phone Drive app: same Gmail → 내 드라이브 → Audiso Music
